Sharing a server and worried someone will mess with your ME network? The §6ME Security Terminal §fgatekeeps who gets access.

It stores up to 8 player permissions with 5 tiers: §6NONE§f, §6ROTATE §f(open drives), §6DISABLE§f, §6CRAFT §f(access terminals), and §6SECURE §f(full admin). Set permissions per player and the terminal logs every security event.

Pair it with a Wireless Access Point to lock wireless terminal access to specific players.

Craft it from Iron, an ME Chest, Fluix Cables, a 16k Storage Component, and an Engineering Processor. It costs 1 channel.

§cWARNING:§f If you lock yourself out, you will need to break the terminal to reset. Set your own permissions first.
